description: Publish row changes of one table of a Dev or Prod database as data events: only the listed columns (at most 32) of each insert, update or delete are published, with the event type data.<topic> returned by this call. Pass that event type to database_webhook_create. The table must exist as an ordinary table of the application, created by a deployed migration; a sleeping database wakes. Rows written before the watch exists are not published, and a published column must not be dropped while the watch exists. Requires confirmed: true and an idempotency key. Refused with project_budget_exceeded while the Stop budget is reached.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: database_watch_create
